changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Create append-only release-candidate command audit and tenant-scoped idempotency receipts.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate_command ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_command_payload CHECK ( candidate_version > 0 AND event_type IN ('CREATED', 'SCOPE_REPLACED', 'STATUS_CHANGED', 'STALE_DETECTED') AND to_status IN ( 'DRAFT', 'BUILDING', 'BUILD_FAILED', 'BUILT', 'QUALITY_RUNNING', 'QUALITY_FAILED', 'QUALITY_PASSED', 'REVIEW_PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED', 'PUBLISHING', 'PARTIAL', 'PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE' ) AND ( from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ( 'DRAFT', 'BUILDING', 'BUILD_FAILED', 'BUILT', 'QUALITY_RUNNING', 'QUALITY_FAILED', 'QUALITY_PASSED', 'REVIEW_PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED', 'PUBLISHING', 'PARTIAL', 'PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE' ) ) AND ((event_type = 'CREATED' AND from_status IS NULL) OR (event_type <> 'CREATED' AND from_status IS NOT NULL)) AND btrim(actor_id) <> '' AND actor_id = btrim(actor_id) AND btrim(reason) <> '' AND octet_length(reason) <= 4096 AND btrim(idempotency_key) <> '' AND idempotency_key = btrim(idempotency_key) AND request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND jsonb_typeof(response_snapshot) = 'object' AND octet_length(response_snapshot::text) <= 1048576 );

CREATE TRIGGER trg_model_release_candidate_command_append_only BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON modeling_model_release_candidate_command FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION modeling_reject_release_candidate_command_mutation();

CREATE TRIGGER trg_model_release_candidate_command_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON modeling_model_release_candidate_command FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION modeling_reject_release_candidate_command_mutation();
